metadata.adaptations: Converted source STL to indexed JSON; rigid rotation and translation to a right knee at nominal 90° flexion; crop and cap shaft ends; recompute normals. No nonuniform scaling and no new anatomical surface sculpting. The source is reference male anatomy, not a patient scan. The ACL aperture is an illustrative surface point on the medial wall of the lateral condyle, not a surgically validated footprint. Articulation is a representative rigid pose, not a validated knee kinematics simulation.
